name: The NFT Marketplace, Inc.
summary: The NFT Marketplace, Inc. functions as a digital and mobile service provider, primarily addressing social networking needs by emphasizing community-level interaction. The company also manages the DealWink engine, an e-commerce platform that integrates collective purchasing, discount offers, and price comparison functionalities. Through its proprietary, consumer-driven group buying model, patrons can pinpoint desired product deals with a straightforward click-and-post method. The platform then deploys automated tools to negotiate on behalf of the consumer, aiming to maximize collective savings. Established in 2008, the firm, initially known as Buildablock Corp., adopted its current name, The NFT Marketplace, Inc., in August 2024. Its operations are based in Montreal, Canada.
